summary:
美超微 EPS 大幅超預期 34.51%、營收年增逾 122%，AI 伺服器需求爆發，本益比 16 倍估值極低，盤後大漲 1.28%，為本批次基本面最強勁標的。
• EPS $0.84 超越預估 $0.62，驚喜幅度 +34.51%，為本批次最強 EPS 驚喜，遠超市場預期。
• 單季營收 $102.4 億美元，年增幅高達 122.7%，顯示 AI 伺服器需求呈現近乎翻倍的爆炸性成長。
• 本益比僅 16 倍，市值 $183 億美元，在 AI 基礎設施受惠股中估值極低，顯著低於同類標的。
• 盤後股價上漲 1.28%，考量 34% EPS 驚喜，漲幅相對保守，或與歷史審計與法規風險疑慮有關。
• 122% 年增與 16 倍本益比的組合（PEG 極低），呈現極罕見的高成長低估值特徵。
ai_view:
美超微是本批次中最引人注目的「高成長低估值」個股——EPS 驚喜 34.51%、年增率 122.7%、本益比僅 16 倍，三項指標組合在 AI 基礎設施領域幾乎是孤例。然而盤後僅漲 1.28%，遠低於財報質量應有的市場反應，這清楚說明市場對公司治理風險（歷史審計問題）的折扣仍存在，並非純粹依基本面定價。這恰恰形成了一個投資辯論：若公司治理問題持續改善，16 倍本益比存在顯著重評價空間；反之若重蹈審計危機，下行風險不容小覷。短期而言，強勁財報提供支撐；中期則需密切追蹤：審計師報告進展、SEC 監管動態、毛利率趨勢（是否因競爭壓縮）、以及高基期下的年增率能否維持 50% 以上。對高風險承受能力投資人，此為本批次中最高潛在報酬與最高非財務風險並存的標的。

需留意：美超微過去曾面臨財務審計延遲與會計違規疑慮，公司治理風險是壓低估值的核心原因，需持續監控。；122% 的營收年增率在高基期下不可持續，未來幾季增速必然顯著放緩，若市場調整預期可能引發波動。；AI 伺服器市場競爭激烈（戴爾、HPE、廣達等），毛利率受壓風險高，且對輝達 GPU 供應高度依賴。

summary_en:
Super Micro Computer beat EPS by 34.51% with 122.7% YoY revenue growth, explosive AI server demand, a remarkably low 16x P/E, and a +1.28% post-earnings gain.
• EPS of $0.84 beat the $0.62 estimate by 34.51%—the largest EPS surprise in this batch by a wide margin.
• Quarterly revenue of $10.24B grew 122.7% YoY, near-doubling in a single year on AI server demand.
• P/E of just 16x on an $18.3B market cap is exceptionally low for an AI infrastructure beneficiary at this growth rate.
• Post-earnings stock rose +1.28%, modest relative to the magnitude of the beat, likely reflecting residual governance and audit concerns.
• The combination of 122% growth and a 16x P/E produces an extremely low PEG ratio—a rare high-growth/low-valuation setup.

ai_view_en:
Super Micro is the standout 'high-growth, low-valuation' name in this batch: 34.51% EPS beat, 122.7% YoY growth, and a 16x P/E are a rare combination in AI infrastructure. Yet the muted +1.28% post-earnings reaction reveals that governance risk (historical audit delays and accounting concerns) remains the dominant discount factor—the market is not purely pricing on fundamentals. This creates a clear investment debate: if governance issues continue to resolve, the 16x multiple offers substantial re-rating potential; if audit concerns resurface, downside risk is significant. Near-term, strong fundamentals provide support. Medium-term, track: audit firm status and SEC regulatory updates, gross margin trajectory (competitive pressure risk), and whether YoY growth can sustain above 50% on a high base. For investors with high risk tolerance, this is the highest potential reward and highest non-financial risk name in the current batch.

Watch：Super Micro has faced historical audit delays and accounting concerns; governance risk is the primary driver of the low multiple and must be continuously monitored.; 122% YoY growth is unsustainable on a growing base; revenue deceleration in coming quarters is inevitable and may disappoint growth investors.; The AI server market is intensely competitive (Dell, HPE, Quanta, etc.); gross margin pressure and NVIDIA GPU supply dependency are ongoing risks.
beat_or_miss: 超預期 EPS 實際 $0.84 大幅超越預估 $0.62，驚喜幅度高達 +34.51%，為本批次最高。
